description: Canadian women's fashion retailer founded in Vancouver in 1984, selling its own in-house labels — Wilfred, Babaton, TNA, Wilfred Free and the Super Puff outerwear line — through aritzia.com and boutiques across Canada and the US, positioned as 'everyday luxury' with premium workwear, tailoring and cold-weather pieces.

evidence.summary: LinkApprove's program page (reviewed 2026-08-19 by its partnerships team) lists the Aritzia affiliate program at 6% per sale with a 14-day cookie window, available to LinkApprove creators and publishers in the US and Canada with no separate Aritzia application; average order value on the program is $180.

LinkApprove recruits creators and publishers for the program from 1,000 followers, states that social and short-form video traffic is accepted across its fashion programs, and names North American workwear, outerwear and Canadian style creators as the best fit for Aritzia.
Aritzia's official homepage sells women's fashion under its own labels, leading with The Super Puff, sweatfleece, sweaters and activewear, and describes the brand as 'Everyday Luxury'.

name: Aritzia

reasons.compensation: A published 6% per sale on a high $180 average order value is solid mid-range fashion pay, though the 14-day cookie is short.
reasons.contact_access: A single platform route (LinkApprove account, decision usually within two business days) but no direct brand application page or published partnerships email.
reasons.credibility: Established 1984 Canadian retailer with a large boutique network and a premium public brand.
reasons.niche_fit: Pure women's fashion with cult in-house labels (Wilfred, Babaton, TNA, Super Puff) that fashion creators already build content around — near the top of the fashion UGC niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to creators from 1,000 followers in the US and Canada with no separate brand application; limited only by the North-America-only shipping footprint.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program is explicitly sold to creators and publishers, accepts social and short-form video traffic, and LinkApprove names workwear, outerwear and Canadian style creators as proven fits.

description: American luxury fashion house founded by designer Michael Kors in 1981, selling handbags, watches, footwear, jewellery, eyewear, fragrance and men's and women's ready-to-wear under the Michael Kors Collection, MICHAEL Michael Kors and Michael Kors Mens labels through its own stores and website worldwide.

evidence.summary: Michael Kors' own Awin EU merchant profile (fetched first-hand) publishes the program's standard rate as 5% for full-price and 3% for markdown (excluding gift cards, shipping and VAT) with a 30-day cookie; the EU account is live in the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal and Belgium.

US listings describe a separate CJ Affiliate program for the USA and Canada at around 2% with no minimum payout, and LinkApprove lists up to 7% — the recorded 5% is the Awin EU profile's published standard rate, with the US figure treated as a regional-program difference rather than a conflict.

The Awin profile describes Michael Kors as a world-renowned designer of luxury accessories and ready-to-wear, established in 1981, producing accessories, footwear, watches, jewellery, ready-to-wear, eyewear and fragrance.

name: Michael Kors

reasons.compensation: 5% standard on full-price sales in the EU program is mid-range for luxury; markdown pays 3% and the separate US program is reported lower at around 2%.
reasons.contact_access: Application is through the Awin merchant profile; no published partnerships email or direct creator application page was found.
reasons.credibility: Established 1981 luxury house with global retail presence and sustained international advertising.
reasons.niche_fit: Global luxury fashion and accessories brand with handbags and watches that anchor fashion and styling content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin for the EU program (four live countries) and through CJ in North America, subject to network approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program runs through major creator-accessible networks (Awin in the EU, CJ in North America) and the brand is a staple of luxury haul and styling content, though it publishes no creator-specific program page.

description: Montreal-based footwear and accessories retailer founded in 1972, selling on-trend shoes, boots, sandals, handbags and accessories for men and women at accessible prices through aldoshoes.com and stores internationally.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory (updated March 10, 2024) lists the ALDO affiliate program on Rakuten Advertising for the CA and US regions at 6% per sale, described as the rate officially listed with the program, with application through Rakuten's signup.

Lasso's directory lists the Aldo USA program at 5% per sale with a 15-day cookie, which conflicts with LinkClicky's 6% officially-listed figure, so no single commission rate is recorded; the program itself is not in doubt.
LinkClicky describes ALDO as a Montreal-based company founded in 1972 that has grown into an internationally recognized brand for on-trend shoes, accessories and handbags.

name: ALDO

reasons.compensation: Published figures exist (5–6% per sale) but two directories conflict on the exact rate, so compensation is scored on the existence of a real percentage program with the rate left unrecorded.
reasons.contact_access: Joining is via the Rakuten Advertising network signup; no published brand partnerships email or creator application page was found.
reasons.credibility: Established 1972 Montreal retailer with international store presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Mass-market footwear and accessories with constant new styles — a natural fit for shoe, outfit and haul creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open network application for US and Canadian publishers, subject to Rakuten and advertiser approval.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Rakuten program is open to publishers and influencers and ALDO is a frequent subject of fashion content, but no creator-specific program page or ambassador structure is published.

description: British fashion brand founded in London in 1994, known for leather jackets, distressed knitwear and directional menswear, womenswear, footwear and accessories, sold through allsaints.com and stores across the UK, Europe and North America.

evidence.summary: The AllSaints programme details (programme terms as published for affiliates) state a default commission of 7% and 12.5% on gift cards with a 30-day cookie period on multiple transactions, with applications reviewed before a decision is reached.

Lasso's directory lists the AllSaints affiliate program on Awin at 7% per sale with a 30-day cookie (its US listing shows 6.4%, a blended figure), corroborating Awin as the network and 7% as the standard rate.
AllSaints' official site sells menswear, womenswear and accessories, leading with seasonal promotions across its full collection.

name: AllSaints

reasons.compensation: 7% default commission (12.5% on gift cards) on premium price points is above the fashion-network norm.
reasons.contact_access: Application is through Awin with manual review; the programme names an account contact but publishes no email for creators.
reasons.credibility: Established 1994 London brand with stores across Europe and North America.
reasons.niche_fit: Iconic leather jackets and edgy premium styling give fashion creators a distinctive, high-basket product story.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to apply through Awin but every application is reviewed before acceptance, and voucher-code sites face lower rates.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running affiliate programme with banners, product feed and cross-programme tracking across FR/DE/ES, and a brand heavily featured in styling content; applications are individually reviewed.

description: French sporting goods retailer founded in 1976 near Lille, designing and selling affordable apparel, footwear and equipment for more than 70 sports — including hiking, camping, cycling, running and fitness — through over 1,500 stores in more than 55 countries and its own websites.

evidence.summary: Decathlon UK's own Awin merchant profile (fetched first-hand) publishes the programme terms: 3% for all non-incentive publishers and 1% for incentive publishers, including sale and clearance products, a 30-day cookie period, mobile and app tracking, no commission on marketplace products, and states Decathlon works with all publisher types.

Rates vary by regional program: Lasso lists Decathlon at 6% per sale with a 14-day cookie for its program, and UpPromote reports US/Canada rates up to 10% by category; the recorded 3% is the standard content-publisher rate published on the UK Awin profile.
The Awin profile records Decathlon as established in 1976 near Lille, France, now present in over 55 countries with more than 1,500 stores, covering over 70 sports under one roof.

name: Decathlon

reasons.compensation: 3% for content publishers in the UK program is modest; some regional programs pay more (up to 10% by category in North America), and incentive publishers earn only 1%.
reasons.contact_access: Application via the Awin profile and the profile invites contact and product-review requests, though it names a contact without publishing an email.
reasons.credibility: Established 1976 global retailer with more than 1,500 stores in over 55 countries.
reasons.niche_fit: Huge multi-sport apparel and gear range at low prices suits outdoor, running, cycling and budget-gear creators, though it is sports retail rather than pure fashion.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to all publisher types through Awin with regional programs across Europe and North America.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The UK programme works with all publisher types and offers product-review requests, but publishes no creator-specific tier or ambassador structure.

description: Global car rental company founded in 1918, offering cars, SUVs, luxury Dream Collection vehicles and vans for business and leisure rental at airport and city locations worldwide, booked through hertz.com and its app.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory (updated March 10, 2024) lists the Hertz affiliate program on CJ Affiliate for the US region at 3% per sale, described as the rate officially listed with the program, with application through CJ's signup.

Lasso's directory corroborates 3% per sale for the Hertz program and lists a very short 24-hour cookie duration; a separate CJ Europe programme shows a 5% default for car bookings, treated as a regional variant.

LinkClicky describes Hertz as a global leader in car rental services with convenient locations across the globe, including airports and city centers, for business trips, family vacations and personal travel.

name: Hertz

reasons.compensation: 3% per completed rental is workable on high rental values, but the roughly 24-hour cookie window is among the shortest in travel and limits creator earnings.
reasons.contact_access: Joining is through CJ Affiliate; no published partnerships email or creator application page was found.
reasons.credibility: Century-old global rental brand with locations in airports and cities worldwide.
reasons.niche_fit: Car rental is a standard monetizable step in road-trip, itinerary and destination content for travel creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open network application for US publishers, with a separate European programme also on CJ.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The CJ program supplies banners, text links and promotions to publishers and influencers, but there is no creator-specific program structure.

description: Global car rental company operating in around 165 countries with more than 5,000 locations, renting cars, SUVs and premium vehicles to business and leisure travelers at airports and neighborhood locations, booked through avis.com.

evidence.summary: LinkWhisper's car affiliate guide (fetched first-hand) states the Avis Car Rental affiliate program is run through Partnerize and offers a commission of up to 4% with incentives to boost earnings by car, date or location; the exact base depends on rental length and mileage, high performers can negotiate higher rates, and a Partnerize account is required before applying.

Lasso's directory lists the Avis affiliate program at 4% per sale; cookie duration reports conflict across directories (1 day on Lasso versus 30–90 days elsewhere), so no cookie figure is treated as settled.
LinkWhisper describes Avis as a car rental company operating around the world, catering to business and leisure travelers at airport and off-airport locations.

name: Avis

reasons.compensation: 4% of rental revenue with location/date incentives and negotiable rates for high performers is at the better end of car-rental affiliate pay, though the exact base varies with rental length and mileage.
reasons.contact_access: Application is through Partnerize; no published partnerships email was found on the sources checked.
reasons.credibility: Established global rental brand operating in around 165 countries.
reasons.niche_fit: A default car-rental option in travel itineraries and road-trip content, with premium and business ranges that suit several travel creator styles.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Partnerize for publishers, with global rental inventory behind it.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Partnerize program provides regularly updated banners and creative in standard sizes for publishers; no creator-specific tier is published.

description: French-founded global vehicle rental company (Europcar Mobility Group) offering short- and long-term car and van rental and subscription services for leisure and business customers across Europe and more than 140 countries.

evidence.summary: Europcar International's UK and Ireland Awin merchant profile (fetched first-hand) publishes a standard commission of 6% of net sales, with affinity/influence, text-link and media-site channels authorized, monthly sales validation and an average advertiser payment period of 60 days; it also warns of partial post-deduplication with an average rejection rate around 40%.
The Awin profile publishes two program contacts for more information: andrea.savasta@awin.com and mouna.saidi@awin.com.

LinkClicky lists a conflicting US figure of $7 flat per sale on Awin; the recorded 6% follows the network's own current UK and Ireland merchant profile, and the flat-fee listing is documented here as a conflict.

The profile describes Europcar as a major global vehicle rental company offering short- and long-term mobility solutions, including cars, vans and subscription services, under a multi-brand strategy with a global network.

name: Europcar

opportunity.title: Europcar International UK and Ireland Affiliate Programme (Awin)

reasons.compensation: 6% of net sales is the highest standard rate among the big car-rental programs, tempered by post-deduplication and a high average rejection rate disclosed on the profile.
reasons.contact_access: Two named program contacts with published emails on the network profile — unusually direct access for a rental brand.
reasons.credibility: Leading European rental operator within the Europcar Mobility Group, present in more than 140 countries.
reasons.niche_fit: Europe's leading rental network is a strong fit for European road-trip and destination creators, narrower for US-only audiences.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin with manual review; the profile warns low-converting publishers risk suspension.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The programme explicitly authorizes affinity/influence channels and offers banner kits and advance offer information, but is publisher-led rather than creator-structured.

description: UK small-group adventure tour operator founded in 1981, running more than 600 guided trips in 120 countries — walking and trekking, cycling, polar voyages, family adventures and cultural tours — sold through explore.co.uk.

evidence.summary: Explore's own Awin merchant profile (fetched first-hand) publishes the programme default commission of 3%, an enhanced 8% for new customers, a £5 phone-tracking bounty per tracked call sale, a 45-day cookie period and a £1,650 average order value.
The profile publishes a direct program contact: Amy Fiske on amy.fiske@explore.co.uk for further information about the Explore affiliate program.

The profile describes Explore as running small group adventure holidays since 1981, with over 600 trips in 120 countries including walking, trekking, cycling, polar and family adventures, aimed at adventurous 40–65+ travelers, hikers and cyclists.

name: Explore

reasons.compensation: 3% default is modest, but on a £1,650 average order value it is roughly £50 per booking, and new-customer sales pay an enhanced 8%.
reasons.contact_access: A named program contact with a published email on the network profile, plus application through Awin.
reasons.credibility: Established 1981 UK tour operator describing itself as one of the most trusted in its market.
reasons.niche_fit: Small-group adventure tours across 120 countries map directly onto hiking, trekking, cycling and slow-travel creator content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin with a 45-day cookie, a longer window than most travel programs.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A published affiliate programme with generic and offer creative and phone tracking, aimed at publishers whose audiences match its adventurous demographic; no creator tier is published.

description: Travel experiences marketplace founded in 2015 and headquartered in New York, letting travelers book tours, attractions, shows and activities in more than 300 cities worldwide through its app and website.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's affiliate directory (updated March 10, 2024) lists the Headout affiliate program on the Impact platform for all regions at 5% per sale, described as the rate officially listed with the program, with application through Impact.
Lasso's directory lists Headout at only 1% per sale with a 30-day cookie, which directly conflicts with LinkClicky's officially-listed 5%, so no commission rate is recorded for this entry.
LinkClicky describes Headout as a mobile marketplace for discovering and booking tours, attractions, concerts and events, with a presence in over 300 cities worldwide.
Headout's own partner site invites partners to earn commission on bookings made through their website via its agent portal or API, with a dedicated relationship manager.

name: Headout

reasons.compensation: A percentage program exists on Impact, but published figures conflict (5% officially listed versus 1% in another directory), so compensation is scored cautiously with no rate recorded.
reasons.contact_access: Application through Impact and a partner portal with a relationship manager, but no published email for creators.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2015 with a 300+ city footprint; younger and smaller than the legacy travel brands in this batch.
reasons.niche_fit: Attractions, tours and shows in 300+ cities are exactly the bookable moments travel creators film and recommend.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to affiliates in all regions through Impact, per the directory listing.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An Impact-run affiliate program plus Headout's own partner portal with links, widgets and integrations aimed at blogs, social channels and publisher networks.
